title: Claressa Shields On Newly Crown Tag Team Champion Ronda Rousey, "She Is The Reason For Women's MMA Taking Off"
htmlContent:
Claressa Shields, the renowned professional boxer and two-time Olympic gold medalist, recently made a noteworthy statement on the Scoop B Radio Podcast regarding Ronda Rousey's impact on combat sports. Shields commended Rousey, acknowledging her as a trailblazer who set the tone for women in boxing, mixed martial arts (MMA), and even the world of professional wrestling in WWE. Shields credited Rousey as the driving force behind the skyrocketing popularity of women's MMA.

"She is the reason for women's MMA taking off, said Shields.

Adding, ""She's great in her own right."

In her comments, Shields emphasized Rousey's immense contribution to the growth and recognition of women's MMA. By dominating the sport with her exceptional skills and captivating personality, Rousey broke down barriers and shattered stereotypes. Shields acknowledged that Rousey's success opened doors for other female athletes, providing them with opportunities and platforms to showcase their talents on a global scale.

While Shields recognized Rousey's undeniable influence, she also emphasized that each athlete has their own greatness. Shields celebrated Rousey's achievements as being exceptional in their own right, highlighting the significance of Rousey's contributions to the sport. By acknowledging Rousey's impact and applauding her accomplishments, Shields further solidified the importance of recognizing and celebrating the achievements of women in combat sports.
